subject: Bug in Global Ectotherm Thermoregulation Hindcaster?

messages.author: 09c5c6465ee62ea2
messages.subject: Bug in Global Ectotherm Thermoregulation Hindcaster?
parts:
Hi

I'm using the Global Ectotherm Thermoregulation Hindcaster website achieve overview of body temperatures, behavioral regulation and activity.

This has run smoothly for 11 out of 12 coordinates scattered across mainly the Southern hemisphere, but using coordinates for the area around Darwin, Northern Territory, Australia, I receive the error 'only defined on a data frame with all numeric variables' for the microclimate, which of course further gives the 'need finite 'xlim' values' for the ectotherm model.

Using coordinates further Southwest works fine, though I had to move far East before the errors didn't occur.

My Best
Nete

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Bug in Global Ectotherm Thermoregulation Hindcaster?
parts:
Hi Nete,

Thanks a lot for noticing this. I've fixed the problem, which was to do with the time zones in the Northern Territory and South Australia - they differ by half an hour rather than an hour increment on GMT and that was messing up the sub-setting for the plots.

All the best,
Mike
